observations: Three photos show multiple PlayStation 5 consoles standing upright, side by side, in various colors: silver, blue, red, and black.
The consoles have the distinctive PS5 design: vertical orientation, curved top, black horizontal stripe, and disc slot on the front.
The blue console has a visible circular vent on the top, which is not standard on official PS5 models.
The consoles appear to be custom-painted or modified shells, not official Sony releases.
No branding or model numbers are visible on the consoles themselves.
The background includes a screen with a man wearing a cap, a fan, and a digital display with numbers, suggesting a retail or electronics shop environment.
Watermark 'ALAMIN ONLINECONCEPT' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: Variety coloured playstation 5. UK grade A
claims.evidence: Photos 0, 1, 2 show multiple consoles in different colors (silver, blue, red, black). The 'UK grade A' claim cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Hacked with trending jailbreak of 13.60 with full power...
claims.evidence: No screen or interface is shown to verify the firmware version or jailbreak status. The claim cannot be confirmed from photos alone.

risks.risk: The consoles are custom shells with no internal components shown; they may be non-functional or contain low-quality or incompatible hardware.
risks.proof: A photo showing the internal components, power-on test, and system menu screen.

risks.risk: The 'jailbreak' claim may be false or misleading; the console may not support the claimed firmware version or may be unstable.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system settings showing the firmware version and a demonstration of game loading.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified or potentially non-functional

risks.risk: The consoles may be counterfeit or repainted units with no warranty or official support.
risks.proof: A photo of the serial number or official label, or a video showing the console booting and running a game.
risks.if_unproven: priced as unverified or potentially counterfeit

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the console powering on and displaying the system menu.
A screenshot of the system settings showing the firmware version.
A photo of the internal components or serial number label.
A video demonstrating gameplay or system stability.
response.reason: The consoles appear to be custom-painted shells with no visible branding or model numbers. While the color variety is supported, the claims about firmware and functionality cannot be verified from the photos. The internal condition, functionality, and authenticity are unknown, requiring proof before pricing.
